title: How Allegro MicroSystems Increased OEE by Several Percentage Points with yieldHUB Live
gist: A customer-reported case study says Allegro MicroSystems' Philippines test operation beat its 1-point OEE improvement target by several points using yieldHUB Live real-time test monitoring, cutting unnecessary retest, raising first pass yield and freeing tester capacity that let it defer equipment purchases.

insights.claim: Allegro MicroSystems targeted a one-percentage-point OEE improvement at its high-volume Philippines semiconductor operation and reported achieving an improvement of several percentage points with yieldHUB Live.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Beating the target by a multiple suggests large latent capacity in existing test fleets.
insights.quote: Allegro set out to improve overall equipment effectiveness, or OEE, by one percentage point.
